text: Ordered a croissant for a lazy breakfast; the rider took 70 minutes and it arrived cold and flattened.
weekday morning ka hot chocolate order kiya, gunguna aaya par spill nahi hua. theek thaak.
Paneer tikka sandwich delivered before a work call, still warm and neatly wrapped. Reliable.
Breakfast delivery took an hour on a quiet Tuesday. If the mornings are slow, where was my order?
Waffle arrived with edges still crisp, maple separate. Weekday delivery seems calmer than weekends.
Cold brew came 45 minutes in, properly chilled though. A slow morning at the cafe, apparently.
Cappuccino to home before a meeting - warm, lid on tight, heart pour only slightly smudged.
Ordered a blueberry muffin, got a cinnamon roll. Tasty, but I wanted what I paid for.
Fries mid-morning - arrived quick but slightly limp. Probably a dish that wants to be eaten in.
Cheesecake delivered at 10 am, glaze perfect, box cold. A weekday treat that worked beautifully.
My order sat being prepared for 50 minutes then arrived cold. Quiet hours should be faster.
Croissant delivered in a sleeve that kept it from crushing. Flaky, buttery, worth the wait.
Latte arrived lukewarm with a loose lid - half the foam lost to the bag. Mornings deserve better.
Iced latte at my door in 20 minutes on a Wednesday. Big ice, strong espresso, zero fuss.
Kulhad chai swapped into a sealed cup for delivery - smart. Still steaming, still spiced right.
Wrong order entirely - a cold drink instead of my hot breakfast. Returned it, reordered, gave up.
Rose milk delivered chilled by mid-morning; sabja seeds intact, not watered down. Nice.
Waffle delivered before 10 am in a vented box - crisp, warm, berries fresh. Ten on ten.
Morning coffee run for 10: three filter coffees missing from the bag. Morning meetings ran dry.
Ten cappuccinos for the 9 am standup - all present, all hot, names on cups. Textbook.
Office breakfast order arrived 90 minutes late with half the items wrong. The whole floor noticed.
Twelve drinks in two carriers; one leaked into the tray but timing was fine. Mixed bag.
Fifteen muffins for the team breakfast - right flavours, tidy boxes, five minutes early.
Team lunch order of 11 sandwiches, each labelled and pressed. Nobody fought over food for once.
Afternoon fries for the team took an hour and arrived in a steam-sogged box. Unanimous thumbs down.
morning chai run for 10 - do cups chhut gaye aur 30 min late hue. team ne adjust kar liya.
Eighteen croissants for a client visit - boxed neatly, zero damage, impressed the visitors.
Grabbed 8 filter coffees for the morning meeting at 8:30. Packed in a carrier, out in minutes.
Stood at the counter 25 minutes for a prepaid office order while they served walk-ins. Unacceptable.
office ke liye 8 cappuccino le aaya, ek galat tha. counter pe wait bhi 15 min ka tha.
Morning coffee in 8 minutes - acceptable, but slower than usual for a quiet Wednesday.
Only one person at the counter at 8:20 and a trainee struggling with the bill printer. Took forever.
7:55 am cappuccino, out by 7:59, heart pour intact in a takeaway cup. The morning machine works.
Croissant warm from the 6 am bake, coffee sealed - breakfast on the go under five minutes.
filter coffee ab 120 ka hai. subah jaldi mein yeh price chubhta hai, wait bhi 10 min tha.
Ready in five minutes even with a queue of regulars. Consistent and quick.
Missed my 8:40 cab waiting 16 minutes for a coffee. Nobody acknowledged the line. Never again.
Double ristretto in ninety seconds flat. They see me coming and start pouring. Morning ritual perfected.
Quick counter cappuccino before work; the quiet 8 am crowd makes it a civilised start.
Wet floor near the door, one barista handling everything, ten minutes for a simple order. Sloppy morning.
dabara filter coffee subah 8 baje - strong aur garma garam. paanch minute mein nikal gaya.
Stood at an unmanned counter for 12 minutes at 8:15. Someone finally appeared, no apology. Late for work.
Office-ordered cappuccino arrived lukewarm. I could have walked there faster myself.
Breakfast to the office arrived slightly cool but unsquashed. The coffee commute continues.
subah 9 baje ka scene alag hai - shant, sasti chai, aur table free. classes se pehle yahi chahiye.
cheese toast badhiya par 260 abhi bhi jeb pe lagta hai. morning mein at least seats milte hain.
breakfast for two crossed 700 - chai, toast, one bake. student budget ke liye morning bhi mehengi hai.
fries subah fresh aaye, seat free mili, par wifi kabhi kabhi slow tha. overall theek tha.
chai 140 aur fries 160 - subah ka nashta 300 mein sorted. yahi toh student HQ hai.
8 am brew: sunlight, empty tables, kulhad chai steaming. The best study slot nobody talks about.
A bake and a table to myself for an hour before lectures. Quiet mornings are underrated here.
chai takeaway mein li, 140 ab bhi sahi lagti hai par college jaate waqt 7 min ka wait.
subah nashte mein fries mangayi, 50 min mein aayi aur naram thi. morning order bhi slow hai.
cheese toast thanda aaya aur extra chilli wala note ignore. subah subah mood kharab.
cheese toast ghar pe garam aaya, 260 mein breakfast sorted. delivery fees ke baad bhi theek.
muffin 40 min mein aaya, fresh tha. delivery time morning mein bhi utna hi lagta hai.
subah ka combo 25 min mein garam pahuncha. hostel se better breakfast, paisa bhi bacha.
shake cup ka lid khula hua tha, aadha bag mein. morning ruined, notes ruined.
fries morning mein bhi crisp aaye, portion decent. worth it bilkul.
iced latte theek thi par 260 + delivery - subah ke liye mehenga. taste ne bacha liya.
Tuesday 9 am: flat white, a warm croissant, sunlight on pink walls. The city still asleep outside.
Weekday waffle at 10 - crisp edges, no crowd, slow drizzle of maple. Mornings suit this place.
Rose latte on a quiet Wednesday; they let me linger over it for an hour. Unhurried and lovely.
Cappuccino with the heart pour, a book, one free table. Weekday mornings are brew's secret hour.
Soft playlist, pastry smell, two quiet tables of regulars reading papers. Perfect slow morning.
matcha subah ke time ekdum shaant mahaul mein. pink walls, dhoop, aur koi jaldi nahi.
Breakfast was lovely but the morning playlist repeated twice in an hour. Small gripe, quiet day.
Cinnamon roll still warm from the oven at 8:30. A weekday morning luxury for 190 rupees.
They remembered my window-seat preference. Small cafe, big memory, lovely morning.
A bake delivered for a balcony breakfast - flaky, unsquashed, still faintly warm.
Hot chocolate delivered mid-morning for a work-from-home treat. Marshmallows packed separately - smart.
A noon dessert on a weekday, glaze glossy, slice intact. Midweek indulgence delivered.
Arrabbiata arrived tepid and clumped. Pasta clearly is not built for a 40-minute ride.
Cold brew and three hours of work on a Thursday morning. Calm room, but 250 each adds up.
Wifi dropped twice mid-call and the only plug was taken. Quiet morning, useless for work.
Empty cafe at 9, plug by the window, iced latte refilled twice. Best office I don't pay rent for.
Four focused hours on a Tuesday morning. Cold brew steady, wifi faster than my home line.
Pipe leak above the only plug seats - two tables cordoned off. Packed my laptop and left.
Two cappuccinos over three hours - fair rent for a table, I suppose. Mornings here are genuinely calm.
Counter forgot my order entirely; twenty minutes for a latte in an empty cafe. Wifi saved the visit.
Quiet corner, dabarah coffee, inbox zero by 11. Weekday mornings here are a cheat code.
Zoya pointed me to the table near the plug before I asked. These people notice everything.
Pleasant morning; the espresso machine is loud though. Calls taken outside, work done inside.
do iced latte, teen ghante kaam, shaant table. 520 rupaye ka office - theek hai.
Cold brew slow to arrive on a quiet morning, oddly. Still, the room was empty and the wifi fast.
Weekday breakfast with kids - quiet room, but drinks were slow to arrive. Ten minutes felt long with toddlers.
subah ka family outing - shant tha par bill jaldi chadha. bachchon ko jagah mili, woh matter karta hai.
Meera warmed the kids' hot chocolate extra and checked on us twice. Gentle morning service.
Two toddlers, a quiet cafe at 9 am, shakes that arrived fast. Stress-free breakfast - rare.
subah breakfast pe aaye, 35 min mein kuch nahi aaya. bachche roye, hum nikal gaye. kharab.
Kids' waffle cut into pieces without being asked - someone in that kitchen has children. Thoughtful.
Weekend-feel waffle delivered on a school-morning tantrum day. Arrived hot, saved the mood.
bachchon ki hot chocolate ek ghante mein aayi, gunguni thi. sick-day treat ka maza gaya.
Fries delivered crisp enough for the kids' lunch. Box kept its shape, portions fair.
Muffins for the kids' snack arrived intact and fresh. A midweek win for tired parents.
Pasta for the kids took 50 minutes on a quiet day. Warm enough, but the wait annoyed everyone.
dono hot chocolate gunguni aayi, marshmallow lid mein ghul gaye. bachche impress nahi hue.
Two shakes delivered thick and cold before a park trip. Kids strapped in, parents relieved.
8 am dabarah filter coffee among quiet regulars - the most Bengaluru morning I could ask for.
Kulhad chai in a hushed pink cafe at opening time. Watching regulars trickle in is free theatre.
Rose milk at 9 am, staff chatting with regulars by name. Felt like being let into a neighbourhood secret.
Avocado toast at 380 stings on a traveller's budget, but the quiet morning made it a soft landing.
Barista pulled my espresso and told me where locals actually eat breakfast. Kindness with the coffee.
Stood at the counter five full minutes while staff chatted. Walked out, had breakfast elsewhere.
Matcha while the split-flap board flipped to the day's brew. A gentle start before exploring Indiranagar.
Filter coffee and a just-baked croissant at 8:15. Simple, perfect, and half-empty - bliss.
kulhad chai subah ki shaanti mein. dabara coffee bhi try kiya, dono first-rate the.
Croissant for the road - still warm, bag neat, out in three minutes. A good send-off.
Same time every morning, same order, out before I reach the counter. They start it when my scooter pulls up.
Cappuccino to go, five minutes, same heart pour under the lid every single day.
Four minutes door to door on a weekday morning. This counter is a well-oiled ritual.
mera subah ka usual ab 10 rupaye mehenga. waqt pe toh milta hai, bas jeb mehsoos karti hai.
Forgot my order twice this week - waited 18 minutes today. Familiarity should not breed this.
Kabir had my kulhad chai going before I sat down. Ten years of mornings, memorised.
Meera asked about my mother's health and nailed the flat white. This place is family now.
cappuccino perfect hai par 220 se 240 tak ki journey chupke se hui. roz aane wale notice karte hain.
My corner, my usual, my newspaper spot - they have kept it the same for years. Morning sanctuary.
My usual unchanged in years - same price bracket, pulled right every time. Rare consistency in this city.
Morning ritual while Dev prepped the day's bakes. Watched the cafe wake up - a good way to start.
New cashier didn't know my usual and it showed - wrong drink, awkward correction. Train her, please.
